decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The existing extension and various outbuildings on site that would be demolished do not contribute positively to the character and setting of the original villa, which is a Building of Local Townscape Character, nor do they enhance the character and appearance of the Spring Grove Conservation Area so that the proposal complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.6 (Identification and Protection of Buildings of Local Townscape Character), ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to Listed Buildings and Buildings of Local Townscape Character) and ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan Adopted 12 December 2003.
description: Demolition of existing extension to original villa (but not the villa itself) and various outbuildings on site.
